Lines 83-213 are dead code that never executes. The EA as written will initialize CExpert with no signal logic and will not trade. The intended logic (lines 83-213) would: create CExpertSignal with threshold open=10 and close=10, add three weighted signal filters (MACD weight=1.0, MA12 weight=1.0, MA26 weight=1.0), set SL=1000 points / TP=5500 points, pending order expiration=4 bars, trailing via MA(12), and fixed lot=0.06.
